== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34656) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Marlin DS ASM.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 21 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 21 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>eac35f6a956d6c3622c6539247b62a80f5ffbd85fe1bc02c63bcda4d54262d6c</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.

=== Printing choices ===
* 3x [[The Phantom Menace (AI)]]: XML <nowiki>12_140</nowiki>. The PC post identifies <nowiki>3x The Phantom Menace (AI)</nowiki>. The source printing was matched to its existing card family and image.
